headline: 4-1 victory: Switzerland crushes Bosnia to secure first World Cup win
summary: Switzerland dominated the match with a 4-1 victory, featuring a brace from Manzambi to seal their first win of the tournament.
details: Switzerland secured their first victory of the World Cup by defeating Bosnia and Herzegovina with a convincing 4-1 scoreline.
The match remained a scoreless deadlock during the first half, with neither side able to break through the defense.
The game shifted dramatically in the second half as Switzerland took control, overwhelming the Bosnian side with a flurry of goals.
Manzambi played a pivotal role in the victory, scoring two goals to help seal the dominant win for the Swiss team.
caption:

headline: Wayne Rooney stands by Cristiano Ronaldo amid heavy criticism
summary: The football legend faces backlash after a lackluster performance, but former teammate Wayne Rooney offers support.
details: Cristiano Ronaldo is facing intense criticism from fans and analysts after a series of lackluster performances on the field.
The Portuguese star has struggled to maintain his usual form, leading to widespread debate about his current state of game.
In response to the backlash, Ronaldo has expressed his determination to bounce back and regain his top form.
Adding to the support, football icon Wayne Rooney has publicly stood by Ronaldo, defending him against the critics.
Rooney's support highlights the long-standing bond between the two players, who shared a successful tenure at Manchester United.
The football world continues to watch closely as Ronaldo attempts to make a comeback and the debate over his age and performance persists.
caption:
